newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake, Va., has no deficit, acts to avert one.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake, Va., has no deficit, acts to avert one.

text.p: Chesapeake, Va., has no deficit and enacted a partial hiring freeze in order to stave off the possibility of one if revenues continue to decrease, City Manager John Pazour said Friday.
Reuters incorrectly reported Thursday that the freeze was part of a move to stem a $19 million deficit. In fact, Panzour said, "In no way would we permit a deficit to occur."
He said revenue increases for the current year were lower than projected, but that revenues still grew by $12.5 million.
"Revenues have held up pretty well but we're seeing some softening," Pazour said.
Additionally, he said, projections were that there could be a $5 million deficit for fiscal 1998 unless the city adjusted its budget.
"But as we go through the year, that will be balanced," Pazour said.
